name: LMDeploy GPU KV-cache usage gauge (1.0 = 100%)
notes: InternLM/lmdeploy main, PrometheusStatLogger in lmdeploy/metrics/loggers.py, read 2026-10-04. On by default and requires NO flag: the endpoint is simply available at the API server port (23333 by default). Label keys are model_name and engine on every metric, where engine carries the dp_rank. Bucket construction reuses vLLM's build_buckets / build_1_2_5_buckets idiom. The most dangerous metric in this set, because it means DIFFERENT THINGS ON THE TWO BACKENDS. On PyTorch it is 'logical GPU blocks referenced by live requests' - blocks shared by multiple requests counted once, blocks held only by the prefix cache or a stopped session EXCLUDED; set LMDEPLOY_ENABLE_REQUEST_CACHE_USAGE_METRIC=0 before start to report total logical occupancy instead. On Turbomind it is bytes held by live prefix-cache and checkpoint objects divided by the configured cache-region size. A threshold written for one backend is wrong on the other. Also note Turbomind reports scheduler metrics for DP 1 only.
